tool_input.command:
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec123/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ "$(pwd -P)" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && python3 -I -B - <<'EOF'
import json,hashlib,pathlib
g=json.load(open('eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json'))
og=g.get('original_goal'); print('og type',type(og).__name__)
for s in ([og] if isinstance(og,str) else [json.dumps(og,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True),json.dumps(og,ensure_ascii=False),json.dumps(og,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))]):
  print(hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest())
print('goal keys',list(g.keys()))
rep=json.load(open('eval-log/system-spec-completeness-report.json'))
snap=rep['artifact_snapshot']; print('snap type',type(snap).__name__, json.dumps(snap)[:300])
items=snap if isinstance(snap,list) else snap.get('files',snap)
bad=[];n=0
it = items.items() if isinstance(items,dict) else [(x.get('path'),x) for x in items]
for p,v in it:
  sha=v.get('sha256') if isinstance(v,dict) else v
  if not isinstance(sha,str) or len(sha)!=64: continue
  fp=pathlib.Path(rep['spec_dir'])/p if not str(p).startswith('/') else pathlib.Path(p)
  if not fp.exists(): fp=pathlib.Path(p)
  n+=1
  if not fp.exists() or hashlib.sha256(fp.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=sha: bad.append(p)
print('snapshot files',n,'mismatch',bad)
print('aspects',[(a.get('id') or a.get('aspect'),a.get('verdict') or a.get('result')) for a in rep['aspects']] if isinstance(rep['aspects'],list) else {k:(v.get('verdict') if isinstance(v,dict) else v) for k,v in rep['aspects'].items()})
print('audits',json.dumps(rep['audit_delegations'],ensure_ascii=False)[:1500])
print('gates',json.dumps(rep['gate_results'],ensure_ascii=False)[:800])
print('gaps',rep['gaps'])
EOF
tail -n1 eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-intermediate.jsonl | python3 -I -B -c 'import json,sys;d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read());print(list(d.keys()));print(str(d.get("merged_directive_for_next"))[:600])'
